request: Order ORD-1001 hasn't shipped yet. Investigate why and what we should do.

steps.text: I’m pulling the order’s details to confirm its status, warehouse, line items, and promised delivery date to decide whether to check inventory.
I’m checking inventory for SKU-202 at WH-BOS to see if a stock shortage is preventing shipment.
I’m searching other warehouses for 38 units of SKU-202 (the shortfall) to see if a single site can cover a transfer.

arguments.summary: ORD-1001 has not shipped because the fulfillment warehouse (WH-BOS) has only 12 available units of SKU-202 against 50 ordered. A transfer of 38 units from WH-CHI can cover the shortfall.
evidence: get_order_details: ORD-1001 fulfillment_status PENDING_FULFILLMENT at WH-BOS; item SKU-202 quantity 50; promised_delivery_date 2026-03-19 (is_past_promised_date false).
check_inventory: SKU-202 at WH-BOS on_hand 12, reserved 0, available 12.
find_alternative_stock: SKU-202 required_quantity 38 excluding WH-BOS; WH-CHI available 80 can_cover_required_quantity true; WH-ATL 30 false; WH-DAL 0 false.
arguments.likely_cause: Insufficient stock of SKU-202 at WH-BOS (available 12 vs ordered 50).
uncertainties: Whether a transfer or reroute from WH-CHI can arrive before the promised delivery date 2026-03-19.
Whether the customer will accept a split shipment if the transfer cannot meet the promise date.
arguments.recommendation: Request an urgent transfer of 38 units of SKU-202 from WH-CHI to WH-BOS to fulfill ORD-1001; if the transfer cannot meet 2026-03-19, arrange a split shipment (12 units now, remainder after transfer) or obtain customer approval for a revised delivery date.
